name: 10016 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10016 (New York) has 916 nonprofit organizations. 356 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 321 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10016 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
